title: Can, could, be able to, may
titleEn: Ability and permission: can, could, be able to, may, be allowed to
explanation:
**Уміння:**
- *can* — зараз: *I can swim.*
- *could* — загалом у минулому: *I could read when I was four.*
- *be able to* — для інших часів і для **конкретного успіху в минулому**: *I'll be able to help you tomorrow. Despite the traffic, we **were able to** catch the train.*

**Дозвіл:**
- *Can I…?* — розмовне, *Could I…?* — ввічливіше, *May I…?* — формальне.
- *be allowed to* — дозволено (правилами): *We aren't allowed to use phones at the cinema.*
formula: will be able to · was able to · have been able to

examples.en: Can you speak Polish? — A little.
Could you pass the salt, please?
examples.uk: Чи не передасте сіль, будь ласка?

examples.en: I haven't been able to sleep well lately.
examples.uk: Останнім часом я не можу нормально спати.

examples.en: Are we allowed to bring our dog?
I'll be able to drive after I pass the test.
examples.uk: Я зможу водити, коли складу іспит.

exercises.prompt: I ___ ride a bike when I was five.
I'm sorry, I ___ come to your party next week.
___ you help me with this box? (ввічливо, 1 слово)
We ___ (be able to) find a parking space, so we were late. (2 слова, заперечення)
I've never ___ (be able to) understand maths. (2 слова)

answer: I can meet you on Friday.
